summary: Master the art of qualitative data management and analysis with our ATLAS.TI training course. Gain valuable insights and improve your research capabilities.
lede: ATLAS.ti training helps qualitative researchers organize study materials and connect interpretations to the evidence behind them. Participants practice classifying transcripts and other documents, developing a consistent codebook, coding and comparing cases, and recording decisions in analytic memos and audit trails; they also use retrieved quotations and visual networks to support clear findings reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who collect, organize, code, interpret, or commission qualitative evidence and need a reliable ATLAS.ti workflow. It suits foundation-level users who are new to computer-assisted qualitative data analysis and intermediate practitioners who want to strengthen consistency, documentation, and reporting.
prerequisites: No prior ATLAS.ti experience is required. You should have basic research literacy, familiarity with interviews or document-based evidence, and access to a sample qualitative dataset or the course dataset. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted coding, automated transcription, and mixed-methods integration are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels rather than technical engineering level.
